column1: # comment: "Citation and credit alignments to CiTO, Web Annotation, and PROV-O. GMEOW rebuilds the constructs natively and bridges by reference (Principle 5)."

column6: PROV-O Attribution is an influence/association; GMEOW Contribution is a relator. Lossy but close.
Web Annotation oa:Selector is the closest peer to GMEOW Selector.
CiTO cites — the core citation property.
PROV-O agent within an Attribution; GMEOW contributor is the relator player. Lossy.
CiTO citesAsDataSource is a sub-property of cito:cites; GMEOW encodes the intent as a CitationIntent value.
CiTO obtainsSupportFrom approximates conforming to a standard; not an exact match.
